subject: Chi-square and degrees of freedom using WLSMV

messages.author: f2659346bc7923d6
messages.subject: Chi-square and degrees of freedom using WLSMV
parts:
Dear all,

Please, could anyone of you provide me good references about how lavaan compute chi-square and degrees of freedom using WLSMV?
I am writing a paper and I want to add the formulas for the estimation of these two parameters in the last version of lavaan (lavaan 0.5-18).

Thanks in advance,

Best regards,
Vinícius

messages.author: f2659346bc7923d6
messages.subject: Re: Chi-square and degrees of freedom using WLSMV [Solved]
parts:
Hello everybody,

I found a nice explanation in http://users.ugent.be/~yrosseel/lavaan/zurich2015/lavaan_zurich2015.pdf

Other valuable references are:
- Muthén, B., du Toit, S. H. C., & Spisic, D. (1997). Robust inference using weighted least squares and quadratic estimating equations in latent variable modeling with categorical and continous outcome. Psychometrika.

- Budtz-Jørgensen, E., Keiding, N., Grandjean, P., & Weihe, P. (2002). Estimation of health effects of prenatal methylmercury exposure using structural equation models. Environmental Health : A Global Access Science Source, 1(1), 2. doi:10.1186/1476-069X-1-1

Best regards,
Vinícius
